scope.summary: Implement sharpen/detail StudioLiveFilter kinds (redistribute existing contrast, do NOT add pixels): Sharpen / Sharpen More (fixed clarity boost), Sharpen Edges (edge-only, parameterless), Unsharp Mask (amount/radius/threshold), Smart Sharpen (algorithm choice, shadow/highlight fade, noise-reduction slider, per-channel + CMYK), Clarity (midtone local contrast), High Pass (edge detail within radius, inverse of gaussian; single deduped kind used as sharpen row AND overlay-sharpen detail extractor, not duplicated across families). ML detail synthesis is the adapter super-resolution row, not here.
acceptance_criteria: Sharpen/Sharpen More, Sharpen Edges, Unsharp Mask, Smart Sharpen, Clarity, High Pass
expected_tests: test: Unsharp Mask amount/radius/threshold; Smart Sharpen per-channel+CMYK; High Pass single kind (no cross-family duplication)
acceptance_criteria_original: Sharpen/Sharpen More, Sharpen Edges, Unsharp Mask, Smart Sharpen, Clarity, High Pass; contrast-only; High Pass single deduped kind

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-FX-019] Sharpen/detail effects increase local/edge contrast. High-pass is one deduped kind used both as a sharpen row here and as the overlay-sharpening detail extractor; it is not duplicated between families.

[STU-FX-019a] The deterministic super-resolution / detail-synthesis capability is split by posture: bicubic/Lanczos and edge-preserving upscale are native resampling owned by 14.4/14.13, while ML detail synthesis is the adapter-backed super-resolution row ([STU-FX-034]); 14.9 sharpen kinds do not add pixels, only redistribute existing contrast. | Studio effect | Targets | GPU | Behavior (normative) | |---|---|---|---| | Sharpen / Sharpen More | R | No | Fixed-strength clarity boost by increasing adjacent-pixel contrast; the "more" step is stronger. | | Sharpen Edges | R | No | Sharpens only detected edges, preserving smooth areas; parameterless. | | Unsharp Mask | R | Opt | Edge-contrast sharpening with amount, radius, threshold producing light/dark edge lines. | | Smart Sharpen | R | Opt | Adaptive sharpening with algorithm choice, shadow/highlight fade, noise-reduction slider, per-channel and CMYK support. | | Clarity | R | Opt | Local-contrast (midtone) enhancement. | | High Pass | R,V | Opt | Keeps edge detail within a radius and suppresses low-frequency content (inverse of gaussian); the overlay-sharpen detail extractor. | --- ### 9. Stylize Family

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
